summary: Validates build operations on schema-backed records and arrays with flattened layouts

traps.quote: Schema-reference and descriptor nesting are at most 60. Repetitions between 1 and 10^18
traps.consequence: Naive recursive schema flattening causes exponential expansion; OOMs on moderately complex inputs
traps.guard: Compute flattened field counts and positions algebraically without materializing full layouts

traps.quote: Return the 1-based index of the earliest invalid operation
traps.consequence: Uses 0-based indexing internally throughout; returns operation index off by one
traps.guard: Track operation numbers as 1-based from start or add 1 at return; preserve 0 and len(operations)+1 exactly

traps.quote: Repetitions, capacities, and default counts are between 1 and 10^18
traps.consequence: Attempts to iterate through or allocate for 10^18 elements; catastrophic time and memory blowup
traps.guard: Track counts and positions algebraically; skip large ranges without iteration or allocation

traps.quote: Descriptor equality is recursive and includes schema indices and capacities
traps.consequence: Accepts partial descriptor matches; ignores schema index or capacity differences in nested descriptors
traps.guard: Recursively compare all descriptor components: element type, schema index, capacity, and further nesting

traps.quote: An array may be closed at any length. A record may be closed only when all flattened fields are filled
traps.consequence: Applies identical closure logic to both; rejects valid partial array closures or accepts incomplete record closures
traps.guard: Distinguish container type; arrays close unconditionally; records close only when all flattened fields filled

traps.consequence: Attempts to construct or store full flattened layout for large schemas; exceeds available memory
traps.guard: Represent state as stack of open containers with current position; compute field offsets on demand

input_shape: schemas (layout terms), root (schema index), operations (commands); up to 200k schemas/operations, 300k layout nodes
output_shape: Integer: 1-based index of first invalid operation, or 0 if all valid and closed, or len(operations)+1 if unclosed
invariants: Flattened record layouts can have 10^18 fields; cannot be materialized in memory
Nested repeats with 60 levels of nesting require algebraic position computation
Return value is 1-based index for errors, with special cases 0 and len(operations)+1
max_scale: 200k schemas, 200k operations, 60 nesting depth, 10^18 repetitions and capacities
